sentences.en: So, let's start, Jonathan, with what you have learned about that last stretch of the Trump campaign inside that operation leading up to its victory on Tuesday

sentences.en: and how it may have differed from the way it looked from the outside.
sentences.zh: 以及它与从外部看到的可能有什么不同。

sentences.en: Well, it was sort of an interesting situation because as reporters who cover Trump, you know, I've been covering him for nine years.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这是一种蛮有趣的情况，因为作为报道特朗普的记者，你知道的，我报道他已经九年了。

sentences.en: Maggie's been covering him even longer than that.
sentences.zh: 玛吉报道他的时间比我还长。

sentences.en: But we basically spent all day every day talking to people in his orbit.
sentences.zh: 但我们基本上每天都在和他的核心圈子的人聊天。

sentences.en: And so, it was this very interesting experience of watching a lot of coverage in the last week, which showed a sort of a vibe shift, if you want.
sentences.zh: 所以这是一个非常有趣的经历，在上周观看了很多报道后，发现了一种所谓的“氛围转变”。

sentences.en: Trump was out there doing these rallies where it was almost like this absurdist experiment to see how much self-harm he could inflict and get away with.
sentences.zh: 特朗普当时在外面做这些集会，几乎就像是一个荒诞主义实验，看看他能对自己造成多少自我伤害却还能全身而退。

sentences.en: But there was also this other side to it, which was his campaign's internal data was very consistent.
sentences.zh: 但另一方面，他的竞选团队内部数据非常一致。

sentences.en: Tony Fabrizio, his chief pollster, his private polling throughout this campaign consistently showed that Donald Trump would win this election.
sentences.zh: 托尼·法布里齐奥，他的首席民调专家，在整个竞选期间的私人民调始终显示唐纳德·特朗普将赢得这次选举。

sentences.en: And there was a real gap between a lot of the public polling and what Tony Fabrizio's private polling was shown.
sentences.zh: 许多公开民调与托尼·法布里齐奥的私人民调之间存在真正的差距。

sentences.en: And so, it was this weird bifurcated situation where rationally they thought they were going to win because their internal data showed that,
sentences.zh: 所以这是一个奇怪的分裂情况，理智上他们认为自己会赢，因为内部数据显示如此，

sentences.en: but there was this anxiety whirring inside them because you never know if your data's right.
sentences.zh: 但他们内心深处却有一种焦虑在盘旋，因为你永远不知道你的数据是否准确。

sentences.en: Everyone's just making assumptions about modeling and turnout.

sentences.en: And the candidate was out there doing and saying things that would sink any normal candidate.
